critical_code_review_comments: UserAvatar backward compatibility is preserved cleanly: non-editable branch is an isolated early-return with a plain <View> wrap — 30+ existing call sites will not see a behavioral change.
Badge size math (Math.max(18, Math.round(size*0.28))) provides a sensible 18px minimum floor for tiny 40px avatars and scales up nicely for hero sizes; verified 40→18, 100→28, 200→56.
onEditPress is passed by reference (never called directly), so `editable={true}` without an onEditPress does not crash — RN's TouchableOpacity treats undefined onPress as a no-op.
accessibilityLabel='Change profile photo' + accessibilityRole='button' is correctly set only in the editable branch — a11y semantics are properly opt-in.
Badge overlay uses pointerEvents='none' so the tap correctly falls through to the outer TouchableOpacity — no dead-zone bug.
Style prop is correctly merged as [styles.editWrap, style] on the touchable and as {style} on the plain View — pass-through works in both branches.

JSDoc comment (lines 32-33) mentions 'dashed accent ring' as part of the editable affordance, but the implementation only adds the + badge, no dashed ring. Not a bug (badge alone is a valid affordance) but the JSDoc should be updated to match, or the ring added in a follow-up.

styles.badge borderColor is hardcoded '#0A0A0F' — this works on the current dark theme but would clash on a hypothetical light-mode surface. Not blocking today but worth parameterizing when/if a light theme lands.

The 2 remaining raw Image avatar sites (session-card traineePhoto at (tabs)/home.tsx:948 and home.tsx:760) fall outside the iter106ar migration list but ARE avatar renders — main agent may want to include them in the next migration pass for full 'consistent everywhere' coverage.
